items.name: patient-status-badge
items.title: Patient Status Badge
items.description: An accessible badge for concise patient workflow status labels. Status is always communicated with text, not color alone.

organui.accessibility: Every state has a visible text label.
organui.safety: Workflow status only; not a clinical assessment.

items.name: lab-result-card
items.title: Lab Result Card
items.description: A structured laboratory result with value, unit, reference range, collection time, and explicit workflow state.

organui.accessibility: Result states and missing values are communicated with text.
organui.safety: Reference ranges and urgency must be configured and validated locally.

items.name: lab-results-panel
items.title: Lab Results Panel
items.description: An accessible laboratory results workflow with summary counts, explicit states, an empty state, and a responsive table.

organui.accessibility: A semantic table, visible status labels, meaningful missing-value text, and a clear empty state communicate every result.
organui.safety: Synthetic display component only; reference ranges, alert thresholds, and escalation policies must be validated locally.

items.name: vital-sign-card
items.title: Vital Sign Card
items.description: A compact vital-sign measurement with unit, timestamp, and a visible review state.

organui.accessibility: Unavailable measurements and review states use visible labels.
organui.safety: Thresholds and clinical interpretation remain consumer responsibilities.

items.name: medication-status
items.title: Medication Status
items.description: A medication workflow badge with configurable, text-first state labels.

organui.accessibility: Medication state is never conveyed by color alone.
organui.safety: The component does not provide prescribing or administration guidance.

items.name: specimen-status
items.title: Specimen Status
items.description: A text-first badge for specimen collection and laboratory transport workflows.

organui.accessibility: Transport and rejection states have explicit text.
organui.safety: Local chain-of-custody and rejection policies remain authoritative.

items.name: clinical-alert
items.title: Clinical Alert
items.description: An accessible alert for informational, warning, and critical workflow messages.

organui.accessibility: Uses alert semantics, a title, description, and visible severity language.
organui.safety: Consumers define escalation logic and clinically validated wording.

items.name: study-phase-badge
items.title: Study Phase Badge
items.description: A consistent badge for common interventional study phase labels.

organui.accessibility: Study phase is expressed as readable text.
organui.safety: Phase labels are display metadata and do not imply study suitability.

items.name: patient-summary-header
items.title: Patient Summary Header
items.description: A compact record header for identity context, synthetic identifiers, details, and workflow status.

organui.accessibility: Identity and record context use structured visible text.
organui.safety: Examples are synthetic; consumers must enforce privacy and minimum-necessary display.
